assessment.summary: This study investigated the phenotypic, genotypic, and biochemical changes in Anopheles gambiae mosquitoes from western Kenya during laboratory selection for pyrethroid resistance and subsequent resistance decay. The study found that metabolic detoxification (monooxygenases) played a major role in resistance, while Vgsc mutations (L1014F/S) were already near fixation in the parent population and did not change significantly during selection.
